serverInfo.name: academy-of-mine-mcp
serverInfo.title: Academy of Mine MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Academy of Mine, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which courses in our academy are published, and who wrote each one?"; "How many learners are enrolled in our safety course, and how far have they got?"; "Show the orders from last month with their status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Academy of Mine data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run academyofmine_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run academyofmine_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run academyofmine_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. academyofmine_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List the academy's courses with status, categories and author, one page at a time. Start here to find a course id. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/courses/tabularlist.

order_by.description: Sort rule as JSON, for example {"colName":"created_at","direction":"desc"}.

tools.name: academyofmine_get_course
tools.title: Get course
tools.description: Get one course: metadata, modules, categories, certificate templates and learning resources. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/course/{id}.

course_id.description: Numeric id from the Academy of Mine admin.

tools.name: academyofmine_list_course_learners
tools.title: List course learners
tools.description: List the learners enrolled in one course, with progress and registration dates. Personal data: use only for the academy's own reporting. Academy of Mine API: GET /api/course/enrolled-students.

course_id.description: Numeric id from the Academy of Mine admin.

portalId.description: Portal id that holds the course.

order_by.description: Sort rule as JSON, for example {"colName":"created_at","direction":"desc"}.
